name: mole_map
description: Ranked neighbourhood (<=25 nodes) of a file or symbol: what it defines, who calls it, what it calls, who imports it. From the TypeScript compiler index with file:line evidence; no LLM.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: repo-relative file, file#Symbol, or a bare symbol name

arguments.name: impact
arguments.desc: also mark transitive callers (what breaks if this changes)

arguments.name: maxNodes
arguments.desc: cap the returned node count

name: mole_tried
description: Commands, tests and edits an agent run already tried, each with its outcome (pass/fail/unknown).

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: run id or prefix, file#Symbol, or repo-relative file

name: mole_claims
description: Checks an agent run's last answer (tests pass, exit 0, committed <sha>, merged, pushed, wrote <file>, fixed) against the run's own tool calls, results and git, as supported/unsupported/contradicted. Deterministic patterns, no LLM.

arguments.name: run
arguments.desc: run id (Hermes/Claude Code/Codex session id, or a unique prefix)

arguments.name: at
arguments.desc: check the answer at this row instead of the last one

name: mole_agent_intent
description: What an external agent-session tool (Entire Checkpoints, git-ai, or Agent Trace) recorded about why a function was written, anchored to that function and re-checked.

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: repo-relative file, or file#Symbol

name: mole_check
description: For a change (working tree vs HEAD, a commit sha, or a diff file + base): the past fix commits that last touched the edited lines, each with its reason, the tests that guard it, and the governing decision.

arguments.name: root
arguments.desc: repository root (default: server root)

arguments.name: sha
arguments.desc: a commit: check what it changed against its parent

arguments.name: diff
arguments.desc: a unified diff file

arguments.name: base
arguments.desc: with diff: the commit it applies to (default HEAD)

arguments.name: worktree
arguments.desc: check the uncommitted working-tree change vs HEAD

name: mole_decisions
description: Every decision and tenet of the repo (.mole/tenets.md, .mole/decisions/*.md, plain ADR folders) with a flag (red/yellow/green) and its reasons at file:line.

arguments.name: root
arguments.desc: repository root (default: server root)

arguments.name: files
arguments.desc: only decisions whose scope covers these repo-relative files or symbols

name: mole_coverage
description: Which agent sessions read or edited a file, when a human last looked, what tests guard it and what decision governs it, with a weak-spot reason.

arguments.name: root
arguments.desc: repository root (default: server root)

arguments.name: file
arguments.desc: one file; omit for the whole repo scan

arguments.name: weak
arguments.desc: only files flagged as a weak spot

name: mole_interrogate
description: For a code change: which decisions govern the files it touches, and up to 3 pointed questions built from evidence Mole already found (diff hunks, past fixes, the governing decision).

arguments.name: sha
arguments.desc: a commit sha to interrogate

arguments.name: worktree
arguments.desc: interrogate the uncommitted working tree

name: mole_decisions_asof
description: What a decision's status held on a given date (application/valid time), from the bitemporal store. Needs MOLE_TEMPORAL_PG; errors rather than guesses if unset.

arguments.name: decisionId
arguments.desc: a decision id, e.g. D24

arguments.name: attr
arguments.desc: the fact attribute (default status)

arguments.name: asOf
arguments.desc: an ISO timestamp: what held at that instant

name: mole_collisions
description: Pairs of agent runs that worked at the same time and touched the same function (or functions within 2 call hops): both run ids, the shared functions, the call path, and which run changed or read what.

arguments.name: run
arguments.desc: only the pairs of this run id

arguments.name: since_hours
arguments.desc: runs active in the last N hours (default 24)

name: mole_priorities
description: The repo's tenet order (.mole/priorities.md), optionally as of a date or compared between two phases.

arguments.name: phase
arguments.desc: phase name from .mole/priorities.md

arguments.name: at
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD: use the phase in force on that date

name: mole_incident_suggest
description: For an incident record, the recorded losing arguments it may revive, ranked, each with its evidence.

arguments.name: incident
arguments.desc: incident id, e.g. inc-42

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: max candidates (default 20)

name: mole_proposals_compare
description: Decision proposals (what-if branches) judged against the approved baseline they were made from, one or side by side.

arguments.name: names
arguments.desc: proposal names (default: every proposal of this repo)

name: mole_recall
description: Past decisions/incidents that resemble a new proposal/decision draft or an existing record, nearest first -- a similar-case match, never a claim that it applies.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: a new proposal/decision draft to recall similar past cases for

arguments.name: record
arguments.desc: an existing decision/incident id to use as the query instead of text

name: mole_hotspots
description: Code areas to pay down, ranked by the Tornhill/code-maat hotspot method: churn x indentation-based complexity.

arguments.name: top
arguments.desc: max files to return (default 10)

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: restrict churn/incident history to commits since this date

name: mole_coupling
description: Logical coupling from git co-change (code-maat's coupling analysis): pairs of files that tend to change in the same commit.

arguments.name: top
arguments.desc: max pairs to return (default 10)

arguments.name: minCoupling
arguments.desc: minimum degree % to keep a pair (default 30)

name: mole_outcomes
description: The outcome tracking log: every decision record with an opt-in prediction block, its recorded outcome, and any staged rollout.

arguments.name: due
arguments.desc: keep only due/overdue checks (no outcome yet)

arguments.name: today
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD to treat as today instead of the real clock
